svg.title: Capsule lit code — SPREAD
svg.desc: Direction D (argued from boards 01 and 07, where the reward pocket reads as a LIT cell, not a printed box): the same shape code as capsule-mark-spread, inverted — warm-white mark on the hot-magenta face inside an ink frame. The audit in docs/proposals/2026-08-look-direction.md measured 0.0% of playfield pixels above luminance 200 in fifteen gameplay captures, so this is the polarity where the pickup owns the only highlight on screen.
